en.hubeali:
Aban, from Abdul Rahman, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The ram in your land is superior than the camel’.
en.sarwar: 8. Aban has narrated from ‘Abd al- Rahman who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
In your land a ram is more preferred than al-Jazur (camel).”’
